set.body:
Make first-level preparation and execution a durable block program rather than a closure-bearing in-process context.

Scope:
- Replace captured-function preparation boundaries with immutable serializable descriptors plus explicit interpreter capabilities.
- Classify engine preparation as DesignOnly, BlockLocal, or GlobalReduction and expose that topology before execution.
- Ensure the supported OLS, GLS, robust, LSS, and reduced-rank paths do not unconditionally read the full selected spatial domain.
- Generate deterministic first-level and spatial-block work IDs; keep each run time series intact while parallelizing across units and spatial blocks.
- Preserve coefficient inference scope, covariance scope, contrasts, sample geometry, and provenance through block reduction.

Acceptance:
- Dense and blockwise first-level results agree within explicit tolerances for supported engines and contrasts.
- Tests prove that block-local engines request only the configured spatial block and that global-reduction engines declare and execute an explicit reduction phase.
- Work descriptors round-trip as data without captured environments or JVM-only scheduler types.
- Shared fit tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Workflow first level: make fit preparation serializable and out-of-core
